$comment: The source of truth for pools.ecash.com and for block-explorer attribution. Add your pool by opening a PR that appends one object to "pools". Every field marked required in README.md must be present. coinbase_tag is the important one: it is the only thing that lets an explorer attribute a mined block to you.

pools.name: bip300.xyz
pools.payout: Coinbase pays the miner directly. The stratum username is your BTC address.

pools.name: avonpool
pools.payout: Coinbase pays the pool; miners accrue and are paid out in Thunder. The stratum username is your Thunder address.
